changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.initial_setup ( id smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, choice varchar(20) NOT NULL, id_user bigint NOT NULL, chosen_on timestamp NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT initial_setup_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_initial_setup_on_single_row CHECK (id = 1), CONSTRAINT ck_initial_setup_on_choice CHECK (choice IN ('USE_TEMPLATE', 'START_EMPTY')), CONSTRAINT fk_users_on_initial_setup FOREIGN KEY (id_user) REFERENCES administration.users (id) );
